notes.title: Optimization update and new content!
notes.content:
A major update has been released that significantly improves the game’s performance!

This update was a crucial step to move forward with the upcoming 8AM titles.

Starting in October, development will begin on four brand-new 8AM games.

Each game will feature 100 anomalies set across unique locations:

[list]
[*] Office
[*] Swimming Pool
[*] Shopping Mall
[*] Subway
[/list]

This release reflects my commitment to the 8AM community, as I had promised to deliver new 8AM experiences within this year.

notes.title: 🎮 Christmas has arrived in 8AM! 🎄❄️

notes.title: HEADARROW 2024 RECAP
notes.content:
Dear HeadArrow Players and Community,

I want to take this opportunity to thank you all for everything we’ve achieved together in 2024. This year has been a true life-changer for me, as I’ve been able to dedicate myself fully to developing HeadArrow and creating unforgettable experiences with games like Doll Impostor, 8AM, The Last Stop, and many more.

I’ve prepared a short recap video featuring some of the year’s most memorable moments. While I couldn’t include every streamer who supported our games, I’ve selected some of the most famous clips from each title to celebrate how far we’ve come together. I hope you enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=0APYKN5Sfa8;full][/previewyoutube]

I’m deeply grateful to everyone who’s been there since the very beginning, offering feedback, reporting bugs, and helping our games achieve the quality they deserve. A special thanks goes to the translators of Doll Impostor, whose incredible work has brought our vision to players all over the world. I’d also like to recognize the testers and players who take the time to report issues and improve the experience for everyone. You are an essential part of our success!

This year marks the beginning of something big for HeadArrow. We are already working on at least five new launches for 2025, including more updates for Doll Impostor, spin-offs of 8AM in new settings, and entirely new titles, some in the horror genre and others in different styles. Additionally, seasonal updates for Pre-Halloween, Halloween, Pre-Christmas, and Christmas are now automated and will return every year to keep the experiences fresh.

For all these successes, and for all the ones yet to come, I thank you from the bottom of my heart. May you have a happy new year, full of fun, creativity, and new adventures! I can’t wait to continue sharing this journey with you.

With gratitude,

David Gallardo.

notes.title: 🎮 The Pre-Christmas season arrives in 8AM! 🎄❄️
notes.content:
From December 1st to 25th, 8AM is getting a festive makeover! During this time, players can enjoy:

❄️ Snow covering the game's landscapes, creating the perfect winter atmosphere.
🎄 Pre-Christmas decorations, with lights and ornaments bringing holiday spirit to every corner of the map.

🌟 This event is the perfect way to celebrate the season while immersing yourself in the unique world of 8AM.

📌 Reminder: The Pre-Christmas magic will only last until December 25th, so don’t miss it!

🎮 Jump in now and enjoy the winter vibes in 8AM! 🎄❄️

notes.title: Haunted Everyday: The Halloween Event in 8AM 🎃👻
notes.content: 🎃👻 8AM is celebrating Halloween like never before! The house is decked out with spooky decorations, blending with the family's everyday life. 🕸️ Carved pumpkins light up the entrance, 🕯️ cobwebs hang from the doorways, and eerie shadows add a chilling touch to every room. Explore every corner and discover hidden details! 🎭 Ghostly sounds and surprises await as the family's routine becomes more terrifying than ever. Dive into this unique experience where the ordinary meets the macabre! 🏠💀✨

notes.title: Working on a Jumpscare Mode!
notes.content:
Hello, "8AM" community!

We are excited to announce that we are currently working hard on an exciting update for "8AM". Very soon, you will be able to enjoy a version of the game with [b]jumpscares [/b]designed to take the experience to the next level of suspense and excitement.

Thank you all for making "8AM" such a great success. We have noticed an incredible number of satisfied users and many streamers who have shared their enthusiasm and adventures in the game. Your support has been vital!

We want to keep improving, and for that, we need your help. If you have encountered any bugs or have suggestions that could improve the game experience, we invite you to share them in this post. Your feedback is essential to us.

Additionally, if you are enjoying "8AM" and feel motivated, a positive review from you would greatly help us. These reviews are crucial for more players to discover and join our community.

Lastly, we are excited to announce our collaboration on another innovative project called "Doll Impostor". This game promises to be a fresh and exciting proposition in the video game field. We invite you to visit and try it for a unique and different experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2882870/Doll_Impostor

Thank you for being part of this adventure and stay tuned for more updates!

By the way, here's a sneak peek of the next game we are developing!
